text: N=128 seed 21 (data_seed 1, m2 fixed) gains about 0.03 force R2 per decade of val_mse_ratio decline over steps 12000-24000. That is close to the about 0.025 per decade for data_seed 0 seeds 22-23. If this slope is shared across seeds and datasets, how far would val_mse_ratio need to fall (about 0.0044 now) for layer-1 force to reach 0.81? Is that loss reachable at d_model=64?
